result_preview.description: Integrates occupational health program data with employee records, enabling real-time visibility into safety certifications, risk assessments, and preventive health measures. Facilitates orchestration of safety-related workflows across HR processes, including onboarding, role transitions, and performance management. Provides consolidated metrics on employee participation in health and safety programs to support organizational risk management and regulatory reporting requirements.

result_preview.shortDescription: Provides customer profile data alongside occupational health initiatives and regulatory audit documentation.
result_preview.description: Exposes customer master records integrated with workplace safety program participation and regulatory requirement tracking. Enables retrieval of environmental, health, and safety initiative metrics, program enrollment histories, and audit documentation tied to customer relationships. Supports incident ticket linkage to customer-specific safety obligations, facilitating coordinated response procedures and regulatory compliance reporting across supply chain and asset lifecycle management domains.
